draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Whitefield! Long before the tech parks, nearby Kadugodi was said to have been founded over 1000 years ago by the Chola dynasty.
draft.hungryLine: Whitefield Road has a branch of Corner House, famous for its Death by Chocolate sundae.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Whitefield (Kadugodi) metro station is a 1 min walk, the railway station about 6 min, and old Kadugodi about 7 min.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Kadugodi Tree Park is near its own metro stop, about a 27 min walk, for some green time.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Whitefield (Kadugodi) is the eastern end of Namma Metro's Purple Line, and it opened to the public on 26 March 2023.

tips.title: Take the metro.
tips.body: The Purple Line starts right here at Whitefield (Kadugodi), so skip the traffic into town.

tips.title: Cool down with a tender coconut.
tips.body: Coconut and sugarcane juice stands all over Bengaluru are good for keeping cool and energised.

story.title: A Chola suburb
story.body: Kadugodi, originally called Kadugudi, is said to have been founded by the Chola dynasty.

story.title: Trains to Chennai
story.body: Whitefield railway station sits on the double, electrified Bangalore to Chennai line.

story.title: The metro arrives
story.body: After trial runs from 25 October, the metro stations here were inaugurated on 25 March 2023 and opened the next day.

story.title: A new junction
story.body: A new 53 km line from Whitefield to Kolar is being laid, which will make the station a junction.
